title: Strawberries 'n' Cream Croissant Cups
description: Croissant cubes are layered with fresh strawberries and a cream cheese custard in these decadent individual treats perfect for brunch.
ingredients: 6 large stale croissants, cut into small cubes

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease 9 cups of a muffin tin; place tin on a baking sheet.
Divide croissant cubes evenly among greased muffin cups. Press strawberries into and on top of the cubes.
Beat cream cheese, white sugar, milk, egg, and vanilla extract together in a large bowl until smooth. Pour over each muffin cup slowly until croissant cubes and strawberries are fully soaked.

Bake in the preheated oven until set and evenly browned, 30 to 40 minutes. Cool in the muffin tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely, about 30 minutes. Dust with confectioners' sugar before serving.

video.description: Delicious and dreamy, these sweet croissant breakfast cups are rich with cream cheese and fresh strawberries. Perfect for weekend breakfast, simply mix the ingredients up quickly and portion into muffin cups and bake. Once cool, a sweet dusting of powdered sugar makes a tempting finish.
